meta.name: Love Me If You Dare
meta.description: As adults, best friends Julien and Sophie continue the odd game they started as children -- a fearless competition to outdo one another with daring and outrageous stunts. While they often act out to relieve one another's pain, their game might be a way to avoid the fact that they are truly meant for one another.
meta.slogan: When is love a game, and when is it not?
